name: rolepod-seo
description: SEO + GEO + AEO site audit for AI coding agents — Quick or Full audit of a site across classic search (SEO), generative engines (GEO) and answer engines (AEO), scored 1–10 per dimension with quoted evidence, ending in a prioritized fix plan that hands off to rolepod-uiproof (rendered DOM, Core Web Vitals), rolepod-wplab (WordPress writes) and the rolepod parent roles. Four skills (/seo-audit, /seo-fix-plan, /seo-schema, /seo-page-brief). Skills only — no MCP server, no hooks.

interface.shortDescription: SEO + GEO + AEO site audit with scores, evidence and a fix plan — for AI coding agents.
interface.longDescription: rolepod-seo ships skills, not tools. Four skills: /seo-audit (Quick or Full audit, 1–10 scores with quoted evidence, markdown report + JSON sidecar + self-contained HTML report with score cards and a colored priority matrix), /seo-fix-plan (findings → hand-offs per owner in dependency order, exact payloads for rolepod-wplab / frontend-developer / content-strategist), /seo-schema (JSON-LD per page type from facts on the page, required-property validation, placement hand-off), /seo-page-brief (intent, 40–60-word answer block, question headings, entities, schema, internal links — for content-strategist). A stdlib-only collector fetches HTML, robots.txt and sitemaps into one table per page; a stdlib validator checks JSON-LD. When rolepod-uiproof is installed the audit adds rendered-DOM and Core Web Vitals checks; WordPress fixes hand off to rolepod-wplab, code to frontend-developer, copy to content-strategist. Zero per-session tool-schema cost.
defaultPrompt: Use /seo-audit to run a Quick audit of https://example.com and give me the three scores with evidence.
Use /seo-fix-plan on the latest audit and hand the WordPress items to rolepod-wplab.
Use /seo-schema to add FAQ schema to /faq that mirrors the visible questions.
Use /seo-page-brief to brief a rewrite of /pricing for "<query>".
